direction.grid: 1366x768 full-viewport: 48px header with official logo left and large 16px+ tabs spanning most of header, 40px compact horizontal rail with equal-width non-wrapping targets, main split into independent reserved zones - rendered scene at least 70%, separate callouts, stations and jobs zones with no overlap - plus 56px action bar; fit without scrolling the side zone by condensing inside its zone
direction.colorTokens: Entirely black, emerald and brushed silver: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22), silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, dim silver rgba(197,204,212,.68) secondary, emerald #A8F04A sole accent and primary fill with #050705 text; stopped = silver cross-hatching, x marker, plain OFFLINE text; official logo immutable black/emerald/silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, no label under 12px, header tab labels at least 16px, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step, minimal narration
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; living material flow, state glow, depth and one 240ms cinematic route trace on real state change; prefers-reduced-motion disables flow, glow pulses and transitions while pattern, x marker and OFFLINE text retain meaning; 2px emerald focus ring with 2px offset; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Compact horizontal rail only from one steps array with aria-current and arrow-key movement; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene with bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; connection readiness checks for provider identity kept separate under its own heading, status and control from the investigation evidence task; selecting a recovery option opens one-click Approve then the Authorize this decision wall; pending task proposal deliberately untracked until human approval; blocked prior tasks and an approved recovery plan coexist while replacements await approval; tab order skip-to-stage, header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone, action bar; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 cinematic factory SVG enlarged to at least 70% of main using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes emerald only, silver idle machines, stopped CELL-MILL-2 silver cross-hatching with x and OFFLINE and no route through it; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline/Feasible-Accepted legend with pattern, marker and text
